name: Maruri Shiina
source: Maruri is a 18-year old female student from Hanatani High School who mostly talks about charisma with her aromantic best friend named Arona. Whenever Arona rejects a guy, Maruri just comes to interfere with the drama between Arona; where she mostly talks about charisma and a little bit of emotional support. She's always on that 'bundle of sunshine' type of energy, unlike Arona. When it comes to Kanashi, she'll give Kanashi that long term support in the near future once Kanashi finds a girl that he'd like. The entire Hanatani High School gave her the reputation title as the 'most charismatic student', which gave her a huge insight in popularity with the boys, including Kanashi.
